findings.reason: Standalone original-resolution audit tiles 01 and 02 contain the side-pairing descriptions but no diagram. The adjacent a-pair and adjacent b-pair are the core concrete data of step 1.1, and a square with boundary arrows materially clarifies both matching parameters and the cyclic word aabb without relying on a picture for the homeomorphism claim.
findings.action: Added a labelled square-schema TikZ illustration and precise explanatory paragraphs in Remarks only.

correction: Added square Q with corner labels v0,v1,v2,v3, a labels on bottom/right, b labels on top/left, and counterclockwise boundary arrows; documented the existing matching-parameter relations and proof independence.

diagram_math_checks.data: Q=[0,1]^2; display coordinates are uniformly scaled by 3. v0 bottom-left, v1 bottom-right, v2 top-right, v3 top-left.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Facts Given and verification step 1.1 specify exactly these corners and their cyclic order.

diagram_math_checks.data: a-pair: bottom arrow right, right arrow up; (t,0) maps to (1,t), 0<=t<=1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Both arrows follow increasing t. Endpoints map v0 to v1 and v1 to v2, exactly the first affine identification in step 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.data: b-pair: top arrow left, left arrow down; (1-t,1) maps to (0,1-t), 0<=t<=1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Both arrows follow increasing t. Endpoints map v2 to v3 and v3 to v0, exactly the second affine identification in step 1.1.

diagram_math_checks.data: Counterclockwise traversal from v0 reads a,a,b,b; all four corners have one quotient image.
diagram_math_checks.justification: All four arrows agree with boundary traversal, so the schema definition gives equal exponents. The displayed endpoint identifications generate v0~v1~v2~v3, matching step 1.1. The diagram makes no new cut-and-paste or surface embedding claim; step 1.2 independently proves equivalence to the standard word.

visual_evidence.result: Native SSR TikZ compiled visibly. Standalone tile 03 shows the complete square: four corners, four closing sides and four arrowheads, with readable a/b/Q and vertex labels. Top and left arrows point left/down; bottom/right point right/up. White strokes, points and labels remain legible on the dark background; no clipping or overlap within the complete figure.

limitations: Checks and preview are scoped local rendering evidence, not a broad proof audit or production route test.
